units: <cite ref="Shabbat 156a:14">Sabb. 156ᵃ</cite> <he>נסתכלתי באיצ׳ וכ׳</he> ed. (Ms. M. <he>באס׳</he>) I looked at my constellation.
<cite ref="Shabbat 156a:14">Ib.</cite> <he>צא מא׳ וכ׳</he> give up thy astrological speculations, for Israel stands not under planetary influences.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 49a:8">Snh. 49ᵃ</cite> <he>עדיין א׳ של דוד עומדת</he> Ar. ed. pr., Ms. Oxf. (ed. <he>אצטגניני … קיימין</he>) David’s star stands as yet (has not yet gone down).
